result.title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CARE-Drive，把自动驾驶 VLA 的自车轨迹精化拆成路点残差修正与位置条件下的朝向生成两个专家，在冻结主干上以监督初始化加强化微调交替优化，在 NAVSIM v1 取得 88.8 PDMS。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其「按物理量分解状态、有界残差修正、交替优化与强化微调分配监督」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的分组件更新与训练调度提供可核查线索。
